title: Link Text Check
description: Prevents links that fail screen reader users browsing a links list by flagging "click here" and "read more", URLs as link text, empty links and the same text pointing to different places, with a one-tap rewrite that lifts the sentence's own words into the link ("To see the venue map, click here" → "See the venue map") and a view of the links list as it will be read out.
stops: Click here links fail screen readers
